Class CardMarket

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.am23.model.board.CardMarket
public class CardMarket extends Object
The card market exposed to players during the drawing phase. Holds two parallel pairs of rows: the tribe cards (top/bottom) and the building cards (top/bottom). Provides lookup, removal and the cleanup / refill helpers that are invoked at the end of each round and at era progression.

    • refillTopRow

      public RefillResult refillTopRow(TribeDeck tribeDeck, int numberOfPlayers, Era currentEra)
      Refills the top row from the supplied tribe deck up to numberOfPlayers + 4 entries, also tracking whether the refill triggered an era advance.
      Parameters:
      tribeDeck - the deck to draw from
      numberOfPlayers - number of players in the match (used to compute the target size)
      currentEra - current era; cards belonging to a higher era trigger an era advance
      Returns:
      the RefillResult describing the operation
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if numberOfPlayers is less than 2

    • handleEraProgression

      public EraProgressionResult handleEraProgression(BuildingDeck nextEraDeck, Era newEra)
